notes:
Composed of ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧ (data) + ⟦{解析|かいせき}→解析：16075_kaiseki⟧ (analysis; parsing). A key term in technology, science, and business fields. With the growth of big data and AI, this term has become increasingly common in everyday media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データ{解析|かいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: perform data analysis
- データ{解析|かいせき}⟦ツール→ツール：11044_tsuuru⟧: data analysis tool
- {統計的|とうけいてき}データ{解析|かいせき}: statistical data analysis
- データ{解析|かいせき}⟦{手法|しゅほう}→手法：12762_shuhou⟧: data analysis method

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧: data analysis — largely synonymous; ⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧ is the more general term while ⟦{解析|かいせき}→解析：16075_kaiseki⟧ implies more technical or mathematical processing
- ⟦{統計|とうけい}→統計：04271_toukei⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: statistical processing — focuses on the computational aspect
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧サイエンス: data science — the broader academic and professional field
